production.scenario: Snowflake warehouse metering rolls query usage into hourly finance buckets for invoice generation and anomaly review.
components: global warehouse execution logs arriving continuously from customer workloads
service boundary that validates usage events before they enter billing pipelines
control-plane service that closes usage into hourly finance buckets on exact billing boundaries
durable authority in Delta tables for raw events and finalized hourly buckets
turns closed hourly buckets into downstream billing statements and credits
control path that reruns affected hours after schema fixes or delayed source recovery
observability path for bucket completeness, reruns, and invoice drift
flows: Warehouse clusters stream execution and credit-consumption records into the billing domain.
The ingest boundary hands validated usage to the tumbling window service keyed by invoice hour.
At the hour boundary the service writes the finalized bucket into the durable usage lakehouse.
Finance systems read only sealed hourly buckets when building invoices and credits.
Backfill control requests recomputation for a specific customer hour after a repair or source delay.
The authoritative lakehouse highlights holes so only incomplete windows are recomputed.
Observability tracks late closures, recomputation cost, and invoice discrepancy risk by account.
